title: WebAnything: From the Wild Web to Scalable Agent Environments
abstract: arXiv:2610.37786v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Web agents require diverse, executable, and resettable website environments for reproducible training and evaluation. Human-assisted mirrors demand per-site engineering, while generative construction can diverge from specified real websites. Capture-and-replay preserves observations, with interaction coverage constrained by captured content and replay capabilities.   We present WebAnything, a fully automated framework that reconstructs source-grounded, reusable Web environments from real URLs without per-site manual implementation or repair after initial setup and authorization. An Explorer-Builder collects browser-observable structures, resources, and interaction outcomes; an independent verifier checks frozen candidates and guides local repair or targeted source recapture.   We construct 244 website artifacts across 14 application domains and 53 categories, supporting 12,984 executed and accepted tasks. Compared with human-assisted Web

translated_title: WebAnything：从野生网络到可扩展的智能体环境
translated_abstract: 网络智能体（Web agents）需要多样、可执行且可重置的网站环境，以实现可复现的训练与评估。人工辅助的镜像网站需要针对每个站点进行工程化改造，而生成式构建方法则可能偏离指定的真实网站；捕获-重放方法虽能保留观测数据，但其交互覆盖范围受限于已捕获的内容和重放能力。我们提出了 WebAnything，这是一个完全自动化的框架，能够从真实 URL 重建以源站为依据、可复用的网络环境，在完成初始设置与授权后无需针对每个站点进行人工实现或修复。其中，Explorer-Builder（探索-构建器）负责收集浏览器可观测的结构、资源与交互结果；一个独立的验证器对冻结的候选环境进行检查，并指导局部修复或针对性的源站重新捕获。我们构建了覆盖 14 个应用领域、53 个类别的 244 个网站工件，支持 12,984 个已执行并被接受的任务。与人工辅助的网络（环境）相比……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: WebAnything 提出了一个完全自动化的框架，能从真实网站 URL 无需逐站人工实现或修复地重建以源站为依据的可复用网络环境，为网络智能体提供了可扩展的训练与评估环境，已构建覆盖 14 个领域、53 个类别的 244 个网站工件并支持上万个可执行任务。
en_tdlr: WebAnything is a fully automated framework that reconstructs source-grounded, reusable web environments directly from real URLs without per-site manual implementation or repair, enabling scalable training and evaluation environments for web agents.
